desc: Base Titanium build: icon reskin, extractNativeLibs, PDF intent, debloat, bundled-extension staging, flag unexpiring, omnibox site search, feature overrides, task manager, accessibility, devtools menu.
Route accessibility checks through complex-user-interaction and touch-exploration state so TalkBack-style input behaves correctly.
Enable the Task Manager and DevTools entry points, including the version-gated branches.
Let DevTools attach to incognito tabs.
Make DevTools render usably on phone-sized screens.
Neutralise the Android media-playback-options guard so background/autoplay behaviour matches desktop.
Make chrome://extensions render usably on phone-sized screens.
Allow Manifest V2 extensions instead of hard-disabling them.
Allow installing extensions from non-Web-Store sources (Opera, Edge, and direct CRX).
Add the extensions toolbar button and container to the phone toolbar.
Anchor extension popups correctly when there is no toolbar button view.
Size extension popups to the phone viewport instead of auto-resizing.
Hide the extensions menu button unless it is pinned.
Allow extensions to run in incognito and open incognito as a window.
Raise the process priority of extension renderers so they are not killed.
Expose extension settings on desktop_android.
Do not filter touch events for security in the extension install dialog.
Fix locale handling for unpacked/content-URI extensions.
Respect NTP URL overrides when deciding whether a tab is the new tab page.
Expose the legacy app API on desktop_android.
Make omnibox zero-suggest and autocomplete behave desktop-style rather than mobile-style.
Desktop-style app menu: multi-window management and incognito-window toggling.
